# One row per service. Fill in YOUR row (don't touch other rows - concurrent
# edits to the same file are fine as long as we each stay in our own section).
#
# `dropped_v1_keys` matters: v2 has no place for some v1 keys, so if we delete

# still reassembles before anyone rotates it.

  gateway:
    owner: ben
    migrated: /shared/migrated/gateway.yaml      # done
    archive: /shared/v1-archive/gateway.yaml     # done
    v1_keys: [service_name, replicas, listen_port, log_level, db_host, timeout_ms, auth_part]
